COMBINATION JUMP: make a substantive, coordinated change in EACH selected direction. 学习目标: Ranking/prediction loss, loss weighting and jointly trained auxiliary objectives. Preserve feature definitions, embeddings, SASRec topology, scoring/readout, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings.
特征构造: Construct input features solely from supplied training interactions, such as frequency or recency indicators. No external metadata, independent scorer or score fusion. Keep learned embedding design, SASRec topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed.
Only minimal shape/checkpoint/predictor consistency edits outside the chosen directions are allowed; they must not introduce another modeling or training change.
specs.hypothesis: Memory available in state; agent should write a short arm-specific hypothesis; Agent hypothesis: Slot-0 hypothesis: combine deterministic recency features with recency-weighted supervision. Scale each nonpadding input embedding by 0.8+0.4r, where r runs from 0 at the oldest valid position to 1 at the newest (singleton r=1), without adding embedding parameters. Weight the baseline loss at each valid position by 0.5+0.5r, normalized to mean one per sequence. Recency features expose proximity to the prediction boundary, while loss weighting emphasizes learning from those recent contexts; together they may improve next-item HR@10. Start from TPE-best SASRec, preserve topology, readout, sampling, optimizer and schedule, and apply to all four categories with one trained checkpoint each. Update the predictor writer to reproduce feature scaling.
